title: The masthead sits on the page ground on every page: the card and its shadow deleted, the nav pills replaced by IBM Plex Mono tracked labels with an orange active rule, the brand doc amended
first: Map: docs/masthead-campaign.md, sections 'The operator's words', 'Body facts' B1-B5, 'The shape' > 'The masthead without the card' and 'What replaces the pills', 'The authority map'. The operator's words, verbatim: 'no card site-wide and let's get rid of those overused pill buttons while we're at it'. Rulings assumed: site-masthead:ruling:operator-ground-behind-masthead and site-masthead:ruling:operator-no-card-no-pills.

Questions assumed: campaign-home = new-campaign (this spec's campaign slug); nav-treatment = mono-labels (option A in the map); pill-scope = masthead-only (.gamecult-repo-link and .gamecult-action are not touched here). Under nav-treatment B or C the deletions below stand and the nav rules in adds are replaced by that option's block in the map.

Land after thing/deck-page-fixes so the two edits to the body[data-slug="Thing"] block in custom.scss do not collide; rebase onto its landing head and re-read the line numbers below (they are from e906f04 and shift by that cut's delta inside the Thing block only; everything this cut edits is above line 1148 or in another file).

Brand sources are canonical: site/quartz.config.ts configuration.theme (codeFont IBM Plex Mono, titleFont Montserrat; secondary #ff8a2a, tertiary #59b7ff, darkgray #b7c7d9, dark #eef5ff) and custom.scss. The brand doc docs/brand-design-language.md is a guide and is amended by this cut because it will otherwise be silent on a decision the operator made.

The masthead component is site/quartz/components/GameCultMasthead.tsx; the nav anchors are rendered at lines 321-329 with class gamecult-nav-chip and active appended. The engine's Header.css sets header { display:flex; align-items:center; margin:2rem 0; gap:1.5rem }, which the site must still beat for the masthead with display:block and its own margin.
Deploy is push to main -> workflow 'Deploy Quartz' -> GitHub Pages at gamecult.org; small commits; CI is the verifier. A local .\scripts\quartz\quartz.ps1 build is optional on Starfire.

deletes.note: Lines 646-665, the masthead card: position, align-items, padding, border, border-radius 22px, the radial+linear background, box-shadow, overflow are deleted. The rule survives as two declarations only: display: block; margin: 0 0 1.2rem (what beats the engine's header rule).
Lines 730-751, .gamecult-nav-chip and its :hover/.active rule: deleted whole (999px radius, sky border and fill, orange hover fill). Replaced by the .gamecult-nav-link rules in adds.
Lines 1439-1441 in the $mobile block, the card's phone padding: deleted; there is no card to pad.

keeps_moves: The masthead's structure and content are unchanged: title, tagline, community links (Patreon wordmark, GitHub, Discord with their sky glow), the nine routes and pickActiveRoute. Only the nav anchors' class and the surrounding styles change.
.gamecult-titlebar, -top, -copy, -title, -tagline, -nav, -community, -wordmark and -icon rules (custom.scss 667-729, 753-811) and their $mobile variants (1443-1485) are unchanged.
The page-header margin-top rules (638, 1435) are unchanged; the masthead's distance from the top of the page is theirs.
The ritual-paper essays, the colossus post, Graph, Thing, tour and Pitch keep their slug blocks; none of them styled the card or the chips, so none changes here.
.gamecult-repo-link (960) and .gamecult-action (2168) keep their pill recipe under pill-scope = masthead-only.
adds: GameCultMasthead.tsx lines 321-329: class becomes gamecult-nav-link (active appended as before), and the anchor carries aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}. No other change to the component.

custom.scss, where the chip rules were (after .gamecult-titlebar-links at 722-728, whose gap becomes 0.45rem 1.5rem): .gamecult-nav-link { padding: 0.35rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; color: rgba(183, 199, 217, 0.84); font-family: var(--codeFont); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .gamecult-nav-link:hover, .gamecult-nav-link:focus-visible { color: var(--tertiary); } .gamecult-nav-link.active { color: var(--secondary); border-bottom-color: var(--secondary); } .gamecult-nav-link[target="_blank"]::after { content: " \2197"; }
custom.scss 646: the surviving header rule reads .page > #quartz-body .center > .page-header > header { display: block; margin: 0 0 1.2rem; } and nothing else.

docs/brand-design-language.md, a new section '## Masthead' after the Palette section (after line 84): the masthead sits directly on the page ground on every page, no card, border, radius or shadow; the nav is the mono-uppercase-tracked label device, active page in the orange accent with a 1px orange rule, hover in sky, external routes marked with an arrow; the title stays Montserrat 200 uppercase tracked. Six to ten lines; reference the rules by selector, not line number. Update the 'Written' line to name this revision's date.

file_changes.change: the card rule reduced to display: block; margin: 0 0 1.2rem.
.gamecult-titlebar-links gap becomes 0.45rem 1.5rem; the .gamecult-nav-chip rules are replaced by the .gamecult-nav-link rules.
class gamecult-nav-link (+ active); aria-current="page" on the active route.
new '## Masthead' section inserted after the Palette section; the 'Written' line dated.

authority_map.owner: custom.scss owns the masthead's look: one header rule that beats the engine's, the .gamecult-titlebar* rules and the .gamecult-nav-link rules. GameCultMasthead.tsx owns the masthead's content and the active route. The page's own ground (the body wash, a scoped variant's wash, the Thing hero) owns what is behind the masthead; the masthead paints none.
inputs: the route list and the current slug (GameCultMasthead.tsx)
outputs: one masthead DOM on every page with <a class="gamecult-nav-link"> routes and aria-current="page" on the active one
the masthead's type sitting on the page ground on /, /Projects, /Blog/*, the three ritual-paper essays, /Graph, the colossus post and /Thing
derived_state: the active route, derived from the slug by pickActiveRoute (unchanged)
the external arrow, derived from target=_blank, which the component already sets for external routes
forbidden_writers: no rule paints a background, border, border-radius or box-shadow on .page-header > header or on .gamecult-titlebar
no gamecult-nav-chip class in the component or the stylesheet; no 999px radius or sky fill in the .gamecult-nav-link rules
no slug-scoped masthead variant: every page gets the one masthead
no engine edit (Header.tsx keeps its bare header rule; the site beats it with display:block and margin)
no change to .gamecult-repo-link or .gamecult-action under pill-scope = masthead-only
shared_paths: every page renders the one GameCultMasthead through the engine's Header
the same Deploy Quartz workflow and Pages origin
authority_map.deletion_line: the card declarations (646-665), the mobile card padding (1439-1441) and the chip rules (730-751) are deleted in the first commit, with the component's class rename in the same commit, before the .gamecult-nav-link rules and the brand doc section are written.
